      Product Description

      Flagship Performance with Snapdragon 7s Gen 3

      • Snapdragon 7s Gen 3 chipset built on advanced 4nm TSMC process.
      • Octa-core CPU delivers up to 2.5GHz clock speed for ultra-fast performance.
      • Efficient thermal management keeps device cool under load.
      • Handles gaming, 4K video recording, and multitasking effortlessly.
      • Delivers power, speed, and intelligent AI processing in every task.

      Slimmest Smartphone with Powerful Battery

      • Measuring just 0.789 cm, the VIVO T4 5G is engineered for elegance and comfort.
      • Built with 3rd-Gen Silicon-Carbon Anode Technology for high battery density.
      • Despite a massive 7300 mAh battery, the design remains slim and sleek.
      • Lightweight and easy to hold, perfect for prolonged single-hand use.
      • Combines modern aesthetics with structural integrity for daily durability.

      Military-Grade Durability

      • MIL-STD-810H certification for resistance against drops, shocks, and dust.
      • Shield Glass offers double-strength protection on front and back.
      • Shock-absorbing frame ensures safety during accidental falls.
      • Drop-Resistant Protective Film enhances display strength.
      • A perfect device for rugged usage, travel, or outdoor conditions.

      Massive Battery with Flash Charging

      • 7300 mAh high-density battery supports all-day heavy usage.
      • 90W FlashCharge boosts battery life rapidly without overheating.
      • Ideal for power users, gamers, and business professionals.
      • Smart charging algorithms protect battery health and longevity.
      • Stay unplugged longer with industry-leading power efficiency.

      Ultra Game Mode for Pro-Level Gaming Performance

      Experience next-level mobile gaming with the all-new Ultra Game Mode, specially optimized for the VIVO T4 5G. Designed for competitive gamers, this mode ensures smoother gameplay, quicker touch response, and customizable performance settings.

      • Instant Game Sidebar: Easily access and switch game settings like refresh rate, CPU mode, and background call notifications without leaving the screen.
      • AI Game Voice Changer: Modify your in-game voice in real-time to add a fun and strategic layer to your multiplayer interactions.
      • 4D Game Vibration: Feel every shot, crash, and hit with ultra-precise vibration feedback that makes gameplay more immersive than ever.
      • Performance Boost Panel: Monitor FPS, CPU/GPU usage, temperature, and control gaming mode (Balanced, Boost, Extreme) for a seamless experience.
      • No Interruptions: Block unwanted alerts and minimize distractions with Do Not Disturb and Auto Brightness Lock.

      VIVO’s Ultra Game Mode transforms your phone into a dedicated gaming powerhouse, whether you're playing casual titles or competitive esports.

      AI-Enhanced Imaging with Sony Sensor

      • 50MP Sony IMX882 main lens with OIS for blur-free photography.
      • 2MP Bokeh camera captures depth-rich portraits with soft backgrounds.
      • 32MP front camera supports 4K video recording and AI facial beauty.
      • Multiple modes including Supermoon, Night, Portrait, and Ultra HD Doc.
      • Perfect for creators, vloggers, and selfie enthusiasts alike.

      AI-Powered Funtouch OS 15 Experience

      • Built on Android 15, Funtouch OS 15 delivers smooth and intuitive navigation.
      • AI Note Assist organizes and summarizes key information from your notes.
      • Super Document feature enhances scanned documents with AI clarity tools.
      • Circle to Search allows users to instantly highlight and search anything on screen.
      • A seamless, intelligent UI designed for productivity and ease of use.
